title: Serve the first order
prompt: Serve the meal that was ordered first: remove it from the front of the queue. Return an array of two things: the meal you served, then the queue that remains. ["soup", "pie"] gives ["soup", ["pie"]].

tests.name: The only order served, nothing remains

hints: Reading queue[0] does not remove it; pop_front does.

docs.name: list.pop_front()
docs.what: Removes the first item and returns it.
